page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The server is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 2 physical cores, indicating a 1.0 thread-per-core topology. It features 4.0 GB of system memory, which equates to a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.
This instance type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network configurations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.large is structured for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without massive memory footprints. This resource density makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for lightweight compute tasks, basic web serving, utility scripting, and small-scale development or testing environments that do not demand high-performance storage or specialized hardware accelerators.
